summary.text: Doug Welton is a Republican state representative from Utah House District 65 who is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An educator and former Payson City Council member, Welton first took office in the House in 2021.

paragraphs.text: Doug Welton earned a bachelor's degree from Utah Valley State College in 2007 and a master's degree from Southern Utah University in 2019.
His career experience includes working as an educator in Japanese, debate, philosophy, and current issues.
Welton served on the Payson City Council until 2021.
He represented Utah House District 67 from 2021 to 2023 and has represented District 65 since 2023.
